verdict.summary: The best beat and tempo follower plus the six signals: beat 78 to 81, tempo 67 to 75 on the 20 tracks, all from three songs where today's half-beats stop; the six signals unchanged

decision.note: Owner: 'add the six signals to MultiBandOnsetAudioAnalyzer and put it as the main'. Done the same day: the signals are in that model itself and it is the default.
